doc: docs/06 §3 dose schedule: control-vector scales per stage (P2.04), read by Steering.gd. `malice` is the tweet-malice vector scale and must equal the `dose` column of docs/02 §9 in game/data/sampling.json (SteeringTest enforces the match). `path_mix` is the stage's path-vector weight — an interim single number: the per-path vectors are possessive/unstable/contempt/hollow/aware/lucid (docs/06 §2) and P3.04 replaces this key with the locked path's vector name(s) and their weight curves. Both keys are clamped to [0, 12] in code (docs/06 §3/§5); no row can widen that. Calmer mode (docs/02 §8) applies the stage-3 row as a ceiling, so retuning stage 3 retunes the calmer ceiling too. Retune by blind-reading transcripts (docs/06 §3).
